# Permission matrix

<!-- Generated by `uv run python -m riven_api.auth.permissions > docs/permissions.md`. Do not edit. -->

Enforced by the API (`require(Permission.…)` on every endpoint, deny by default) and mirrored in the dashboard, which hides actions the caller cannot perform.

| Permission | Meaning | Owner | Admin | Maintainer | Reviewer | Viewer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `org.read` | See the organization | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `org.update` | Rename the organization | ✓ | ✓ | — | — | — |
| `org.delete` | Delete the organization | ✓ | — | — | — | — |
| `org.security` | Change security policy (require MFA) | ✓ | ✓ | — | — | — |
| `members.read` | See members | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `members.invite` | Invite members | ✓ | ✓ | — | — | — |
| `members.update_role` | Change a member's role | ✓ | ✓ | — | — | — |
| `members.remove` | Remove a member | ✓ | ✓ | — | — | — |
| `api_keys.read` | See service accounts and API keys (never the secrets) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | — | — |
| `api_keys.manage` | Create, rotate and revoke API keys | ✓ | ✓ | — | — | — |
| `repos.read` | See repositories | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `repos.manage` | Connect and configure repositories | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | — | — |
| `changes.read` | See changes and who produced them | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `changes.submit` | Submit a change for verification | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | — | — |
| `runs.read` | See verification runs and logs | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `runs.cancel` | Cancel a verification run | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | — | — |
| `bugs.read` | See bug memory | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `bugs.confirm` | Confirm or dismiss a detected bug | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | — |
| `reviews.approve` | Approve or reject a 'Needs Review' run | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | — |
| `locks.create` | Create a regression lock | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | — | — |
| `locks.retire` | Retire a regression lock | ✓ | ✓ | — | — | — |
| `graph.read` | Explore the causal graph | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `audit.read` | Read the audit log | ✓ | ✓ | — | — | — |

## Rules

- Only owners can make someone an owner, change an owner's role or remove an owner.
- An organization always keeps at least one owner.
- A service account's API key carries explicit scopes; each scope must be a permission its creator holds (S03.4).
- Independence: whoever produced a change can never approve its review (S07.6).
